title: Clinic visits (one row per patient visit)
summary: Patient-level clinical visit records from Valdena clinics, one row per visit, covering 2019-01-01 to present (daily refresh). Schema includes pseudonymised patient_key, visit timestamp, age_band, postcode and diagnosis_code. Contains PII (patient_key, age_band, postcode). The Data Protection Office explicitly prohibits use for this analysis per the clinic_data_policy wiki page (last edited 2025-02-01). Access requires Data Protection Office approval, which the policy states will not be granted for this use case. The catalog entry records ~900K rows.

schema.notes: All 5 columns are documented in the catalog; patient_key, age_band and postcode are marked as PII.

spatial.notes: Spatial coverage is Valdena district postcodes only. Single Italian city area.
